evidence: Pam/bubble-glass soda clocks with original glass bring $300-700; comparable lighted Pam advertising clock lots e.g. https://rmsothebys.com/auctions/hh16/lots/r5040-an-illuminated-kendall-2000-mile-oil-by-pam-clock-co-145-diameter . Original face shows ageing, not a reproduction.
sale: A Lifetime of Memories In Arlington
note: Check back for Pam Clock Co. (New Rochelle NY) label, that it lights and runs, glass uncracked, no rust on can. Worth it under ~$150.

what: Watercolor signed "A J Merrill" lower left, Native woman/pueblo scene with adobe and tree; likely Arthur J. Merrill (1885-1973), Taos/Southwest watercolorist with a work in the Harwood Museum.
evidence: Harwood Museum holds his "Taos Street Scene" watercolor (https://harwood.emuseum.com/objects/3670/taos-street-scene); EBTH sold a signed "A.J Merrill 35" watercolor (https://ebth.com/items/4240261-arthur-j-merrill-watercolor-maritime-scene). No public hammer prices found; Taos-subject regional watercolors typically $300-800.
sale: J Elliott Est-Wagner Cast Iron, MCM, PYREX, Crystal, Antiques, Cottagecore, Garden, Tools,
note: Marginal: buy only if tagged under ~$100. Confirm it is a hand-painted watercolor (not print), look for a date next to the signature (1930s-40s best) and any Taos/New Mexico label on the back. Sale description does not mention art, so likely priced as decor.

what: R.C. Gorman hand-pulled lithograph of a seated shawled woman with fringe, pencil-signed "R.C. Gorman" and dated (looks like 1977) lower left, pencil edition number lower right (looks like x/75), deckle edges, framed.
evidence: 1977 Gorman litho "Taos Pueblo Woman" (ed. 50) listed $598 by a dealer with condition issues: https://sheaferking.com/products/r-c-gorman-signed-taos-pueblo-woman-limited-edition-lithograph ; Revere notes 1970s-80s Gorman lithos dominate his auction market: https://www.revereauctions.com/the-market-for-a-modern-master-of-navajo-art/
sale: Estate Sale By Just Peachy: Crafts, Christmas and Collectibles Estate Sale
note: Buy under ~$150. Confirm pencil (not plate-printed) signature and edition number, deckle-edge lithograph paper (not offset poster - look for halftone dots with a loupe), and note title/printer chop (Tamarind/Western Graphics) on back. Frame ~30x38 in, fits passenger seat/back seat. Company field is blank: check the sale page for the operator.

what: Framed 1885 Ulysses S. Grant "In Memoriam" printed fringed silk/textile from Memorial Services, City Park, Dayton, Ohio, Saturday Aug 8 1885 - period regional memorial piece
evidence: RR Auction sold a 2.75x6.75 in Grant 1885 Albany funeral silk ribbon for $963 (Dec 2024): https://www.rrauction.com/auctions/lot-detail/li/349443107050067/cat/0 ; Jeff Bridgman dealer handles same class: https://jeffbridgman.com/inventory/ulysses-.-grant-memorial-ribbon-new-york-1885-o4112.html
note: Confirm it is printed silk (not modern paper repro), check staining/tears and the left panel text; larger Dayton-specific piece is scarcer than standard ribbons. Buy under ~$150.

what: Pair of Chinese blue-and-white "Double Happiness" (shuangxi) jars with later wood lids, likely late Qing 19th c
evidence: Similar late-19th-c pair asking $985 on Chairish: https://www.chairish.com/product/21094141/late-19th-century-pair-of-double-happiness-ginger-jars ; Leland Little sold 9 in. 19th-c pair with later wooden covers: https://lelandlittle.com/items/442121/a-pair-of-chinese-blue-and-white-double-happiness-ginger-jars
note: Turn over: want unglazed sandy/orange-toned foot ring, kiln grit, slightly bluish glaze, hand-painted irregular scrolls; reject if bright white glaze, glazed base, or stenciled-looking uniform painting (modern Jingdezhen repro). Check rims for chips/hairlines. Pair under ~$150 is a buy.

what: Leica screw-mount rangefinder (III-series, knurled chrome dial visible) in original brown Leitz ever-ready case
evidence: Leica III-series bodies with 5cm lens commonly sell several hundred dollars; value driven by lens/condition https://rangefinderforum.com/goto/post?id=4962107 ; sold listings e.g. https://www.ebay.de/itm/157286392875
note: Open case: model (IIIc/IIIf), serial, lens (Elmar/Summitar/Summicron), shutter firing at all speeds, fungus/haze; also check rest of the "collection of cameras" for Leitz lenses. Pass if tagged over ~$200 for body+Elmar

what: Andy Warhol / Paul Morrissey / Viva event poster, University of St. Thomas (Houston), 1968, hand-signed "Andy Warhol 68" in marker plus "Viva!" signature; water staining at lower margin
evidence: Signed Warhol posters: RR Auction signed 1971 Tate poster sold $11,250 https://rrauction.com/auctions/lot-detail/li/347780106696094/cat/0 ; Antiques Roadshow signed 1970 Warhol poster appraised $3,000-4,000 auction https://dipsy.pbs.org/wgbh/roadshow/appraisals/signed-1970-andy-warhol-poster
sale: ESTATE SALE — UNIQUE FINDS & TIMELESS TREASURES!
note: Close-up of signature in listing suggests company knows it is signed - expect a real price; worth buying under ~$500. Check signature is ink (not printed), dated 68, provenance story (attendee at UST/Menil 1968 event), staining extent, full poster image. Sale moved offsite to warehouse; address released Fri Oct 16 9am; sale Sat-Sun 9-1. Authentication (JSA/PSA) needed before resale

what: VEB Freiberger Prazisionsmechanik (East German) micrometer-drum marine sextant, cream frame, scope, wooden box, blue certificate/manual (owner name "Walker Brents" written on frame)
evidence: Freiberger drum sextants hold real resale value: used listing $499 https://www.ebay.com/itm/267041489097 ; dealer-sold examples https://landandseacollection.com/?p=13459 ; new Freiberger drum sextants still retail from nautical dealers https://mdnautical.com/freiberger-sextants/19728-freiberger-drum-sextant.html
note: Buy at $200 or less. Make sure mirrors are unsilvered/clean and not cracked, the drum turns smoothly, the telescope is present (the black piece in the box), and the certificate is in the lid. Owner name is written in marker on the frame, which hurts value a little.

what: Blickensderfer No. 7 portable typewriter (c.1897-1916) with original oak base and Blickensderfer-labeled bentwood case
evidence: Blick 7 in its original wood case sold for $750 from a dealer https://www.ima-usa.com/products/original-1897-blickensdefer-no-7-portable-typewriter-in-original-wood-case-clandestine-issue ; model reference https://typewriterdatabase.com/1899-blickensderfer-7.28766.typewriter ; private-party sales typically run $300-500.
sale: North Dallas Time Capsule Estate Sale 50+ years!
note: Buy at $150 or less. Make sure the typewheel is present (the missing-wheel ones lose most of their value), the keys depress and the wheel rotates, the case lid and lock are complete, and there is no heavy rust. Note whether the keys are yellow; yellow keys are rarer.

what: American Airlines eagle-and-AA round dimensional sign, about 3 ft, red ring with raised blue eagle and letters
evidence: The DFW area is AA's home and original airline signage surfaces here; a vintage AA eagle sign is listed at $2,199 https://www.ebay.com/itm/166483668671 (asking, not sold). Logo dating https://www.logohistories.com/p/american-airlines-logo-1967
sale: Lori's Estates- Charming Cottagecore Vtg Bedford Estate |  Longaberger, Spode & More!
note: Decide whether it is original or a decorator reproduction. Original: molded fiberglass or acrylic with mounting hardware, a fabricator label on the back, and real wear on the paint. Reproduction: MDF/CNC wood or thin plastic with no label. Buy at $250 or less if original, otherwise pass. Measure it against the passenger seat (about 36 in diameter).

what: Jaeger-LeCoultre Atmos clock, cal. 540 "Classique" (Swiss, gilt case, skeleton dial), with a 1981 presentation plaque engraved to James L. Basham
evidence: Atmos Classique hammered at EUR 2,800 at Quittenbaum https://www.quittenbaum.de/en/auctions/design/173B/jaeger-lecoultre-le-sentier-schweiz-table-clock-atmos-classic-1980s-128844/ ; a dealer listed a 1987 cal. 540 at 3,900 https://everywatch.com/jaeger-lecoultre/atmos/watch-14098808 ; US secondhand units with a presentation plaque usually sell for $700-1,200
sale: AMAZING 5000sqft SOUTHERN CHARM ART GALLERY KITCHEN FALL CHRISTMAS!
note: Buy only if the price is under about $350. The caption does not name it, but Cottage Classics is a high-end gallery sale and may know what it is. Check that the balance wheel (the rotating torsion pendulum) turns, that the movement is locked (lever under the base), that the glass is not cracked and the case corners are not dented. The plaque lowers the value; it can be unscrewed.

what: Chest of about 60 pieces of ornate Baroque-pattern flatware, looks like Wallace Grande Baroque; it could be sterling or a silverplate copy (Godinger and others)
evidence: Wallace Grande Baroque sterling service for 12 sold at Bonhams https://wwtest.bonhams.com/auction/30919/lot/76/wallace-grand-baroque-sterling-silver-flatware-service ; service for 12 with 64 pieces listed at https://antiquecupboard.net/products/grande-baroque-by-wallace-sterling-silver-flatware-set-for-12-service-64-pieces
sale: ESTATE SALE~PLEASANT VIEW DR by DAVID C TURNER, DALLAS ESTATE SALES
note: The photo is dark and the marks cannot be read. Flip a fork: if it is stamped "Wallace Sterling" or "Sterling", it is worth $1,500 or more just for the silver weight, so buy if the price is anything near silverplate pricing. If it is stamped Godinger, silverplate, EP or IS, walk away. David C. Turner is a professional company, so sterling will probably be priced as sterling.
